description: Fetch bilateral trade flow records — the primary data retrieval tool. Returns trade value in USD (primaryValue — FOB for exports, CIF for imports), quantity, net weight, and period/commodity/partner metadata for each row. Accepts multiple periods and commodity codes per call; pass partner_code 0 to get totals aggregated across all partners. Omit cmd_code or pass "TOTAL" to aggregate all commodities. Preview makes one paced request per served period, with a 500-record cap per request. Use comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve reporter/partner codes and comtrade_search_commodities to resolve HS codes. For SITC, supply codes from the selected SITC revision.

classification.description: Goods classification: HS/H0–H6 or SITC S1–S4/SS. Defaults to combined HS.

cmd_code.description: HS or SITC commodity codes to query. Serves the first 20 codes and discloses the remainder; input ceiling 200. Pass ["TOTAL"] or omit to aggregate all commodities. Use comtrade_search_commodities for HS codes only.

flow_code.description: Trade flow direction: M=imports, X=exports, RX=re-exports, RM=re-imports.

partner_code.description: M49 code of the trade partner. Use 0 to aggregate across all partners (World total). Omit to get a disaggregated breakdown by partner country.

period.description: One or more periods to query. Annual: "YYYY" (e.g. ["2022", "2023"]). Monthly: "YYYYMM" (e.g. ["202201", "202202"]). Serves the first 12 periods and discloses the remainder; input ceiling 120.

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country. Use comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve names to codes.

name: comtrade_get_trade_flows

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no records are returned. Absent on successful responses.

items.description: A single bilateral trade flow record.

aggrLevel.description: Commodity aggregation level supplied by UN Comtrade.

cmdCode.description: HS or SITC commodity code or "TOTAL".

flowCode.description: Trade flow: M=import, X=export, RX=re-export, RM=re-import.

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated or aggregated by UN.

netWgt.description: Net weight in kg. Often null for aggregated rows.

period.description: Period (YYYY for annual, YYYYMM for monthly).

primaryValue.description: Primary trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

qty.description: Quantity in commodity-specific units. Often null for aggregated rows.

referenceNotice.description: Notice when reference descriptions could not be loaded; codes and trade values remain available.

shown.description: Number of records returned in this response.

totalCount.description: Sum of upstream response counts before local filtering; not a full match count when capped.

truncated.description: True when any preview response reached 500 and may be incomplete.

truncationHint.description: Query narrowing and authenticated access guidance when possibly incomplete.

unservedCmdCodes.description: Commodity codes beyond the 20-code work cap; query them separately.

unservedPeriods.description: Periods beyond the 12-period work cap; query them separately.

title: Get Trade Flow Records
